subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should ClawScan accept the same JSON5 manifest grammar as OpenClaw, or intentionally publish a narrower strict-JSON plugin contract?
rationale: Both directions are technically possible, but choosing a deliberately narrower public contract—and rejecting host-valid plugins—requires explicit product ownership rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Match OpenClaw JSON5
options.body: Use a host-compatible JSON5 parser and add comment/trailing-comma regression cases while preserving the existing untrusted-file safeguards.

options.title: Sponsor Strict JSON
options.body: Explicitly approve and document that ClawScan scans only the strict-JSON subset even when OpenClaw accepts the plugin.

recommendation.title: Match OpenClaw JSON5
recommendation.body: Use a host-compatible JSON5 parser and add comment/trailing-comma regression cases while preserving the existing untrusted-file safeguards.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested code owner and the strongest recent owner of ClawHub scanner and prompt parity behavior.
